name: mcp.rankspot.ai
description:
RankSpot gives Claude live SEO and AI-search data for your own website, so you can research and act without leaving the conversation.

Ask in plain English and Claude calls the right tools: discover untapped keywords with real search volume, competition, and an opportunity score; cluster related terms so one article can rank for dozens of queries; add competitor domains to see the keywords and backlinks they win on; surface high-authority sites linking to competitors but not to you; mine People Also Ask questions for FAQ sections; and pull Google Search Console quick wins like high-impression, low-CTR pages.

RankSpot also tracks how AI answer engines see your brand. Check your visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and AI Overviews, review the exact answers and pages they cite, see which searches they run under the hood, and find forum threads where your audience asks questions AI engines learn from.

Everything runs on your RankSpot workspace data through one hosted endpoint with OAuth sign-in. No local install. Requires a RankSpot account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.rankspot.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.rankspot.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rankspot.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.rankspot.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.rankspot.ai lists 55 MCP tools, including rankspot_add_ai_prompt, rankspot_add_competitor, rankspot_add_keywords, rankspot_ai_visibility_summary, rankspot_archive_ai_citation, rankspot_archive_ai_fanout_query, rankspot_archive_ai_prompt, rankspot_archive_backlink, rankspot_archive_forum_opportunity, rankspot_archive_keyword, rankspot_archive_people_also_ask, and rankspot_create_action.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.rankspot.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.rankspot.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
mcp.rankspot.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.rankspot.ai is developed by RankSpot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
